claims.claim: AMD said Helios racks are powered in Microsoft labs and that it is working with Azure on its next-generation rack-scale AI platform, with Azure among the first cloud providers bringing Helios to life.
claims.episode_span: AMD says Helios racks are powered in Microsoft labs.
claims.source_title: AMD Helios Racks Powered in Microsoft Azure Labs
claims.supporting_quote: Helios racks are powered in @Microsoft labs.

claims.claim: ASRock Industrial launched RBK-100 Robotics-in-a-Box powered by the NUC BOX-358H with an Intel Core Ultra X7 Processor 358H, including an RGB depth camera, a 6-DOF arm set, and AiRoboStarter software.
claims.episode_span: ASRock Industrial launched RBK-100 Robotics-in-a-Box, built around the NUC BOX-358H and the Intel Core Ultra X7 Processor 358H.
claims.source_title: (PR) ASRock Industrial Unveils Robotics-in-a-Box to Democratize Physical AI Development

claims.claim: Jetway introduced the MTX-RYZ1 Mini-ITX board with a Ryzen 7 PRO 8845HS with 8 cores, 16 threads, and a 3.8 GHz base clock, supporting up to 96 GB of DDR5-5600.
claims.episode_span: Jetway introduced the MTX-RYZ1 Mini-ITX industrial board around the Ryzen 7 PRO 8845HS, an AMD Hawk Point Zen 4 chip with 8 cores, 16 threads, and a 3.8 GHz base clock

claims.supporting_quote: The AMD "Hawk Point" Zen 4 chip has 8 cores and 16 threads with a 3.8 GHz base clock, and it's aimed mostly at embedded systems and industrial applications.

claims.episode_span: Bitera, a carrier-neutral data center in Jakarta’s Kuningan district, has completed a SOC 2 Type II audit.
claims.source_title: Sponsored: Bitera completes SOC 2 Type II Audit, strengthening governance to international standards
claims.supporting_quote: The carrier-neutral data center in Jakarta’s Kuningan district has also maintained 100 percent power availability since opening in 2024

claims.claim: JUPITER remains among the five fastest supercomputers, Europe's most powerful, and the most energy-efficient in the exascale class, with two projects nominated for ACM Gordon Bell Prizes.

claims.source_title: JUPITER Remains Among the 5 Fastest Supercomputers and Europe’s No. 1
claims.supporting_quote: JUPITER continues to rank among the five fastest supercomputers in the world and remains Europe’s most powerful supercomputer.

claims.claim: Digitimes reported TSMC is considering a $22.6 billion Texas campus including about $14 billion in machinery and equipment, weighing Texas against Arizona.
claims.episode_span: Digitimes reports TSMC is considering a $22.6 billion semiconductor campus in Texas, including about $14 billion in machinery and equipment
claims.source_title: TSMC eyes US$22.6 billion Texas campus for 2nm chips
claims.supporting_quote: TSMC is considering a US$22.6 billion semiconductor manufacturing campus in Texas, including about US$14 billion in machinery and equipment investment, as the chipmaker weighs Texas against Arizona for its next major US expansion.

claims.claim: A TSMC unit applied to the Texas Comptroller under the Jobs, Energy, Technology and Innovation program for a property-tax cap on a planned Brazos County facility of more than 3,200 acres for 2-nanometer or more advanced chips, estimating at least 2,099 direct jobs over four decades, and named Arizona, where it has operated a plant since late 2024, as the alternative.
claims.episode_span: the unit applied to the Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts under the Jobs, Energy, Technology and Innovation program for a property-tax cap
claims.source_title: Chipmaker TSMC seeks property tax cap for $22.6 billion Texas plant — Channel NewsAsia
claims.supporting_quote: The company filed an application with the Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts under the Jobs, Energy, Technology and Innovation program.

claims.claim: Taiwan News reported TSMC eyes an NT$743 billion chipmaking facility in Texas.
claims.episode_span: Taiwan News frames the same Texas plan at NT$743 billion.
claims.source_title: TSMC eyes NT$743 billion chipmaking facility in Texas
claims.supporting_quote: TSMC eyes NT$743 billion chipmaking facility in Texas

claims.claim: On November 23 the US Commerce Department moved to add Megaspeed and six related companies in Singapore, Malaysia, and Thailand to the Entity List.
claims.episode_span: On November 23 the US Commerce Department moved to add Megaspeed and six related companies to the Entity List
claims.source_title: S’pore working with US on chip export enforcement as Megaspeed probe continues: PM Wong
claims.supporting_quote: The US Commerce Department on Nov 23 moved to add Megaspeed and six related companies to its Entity List, citing the risk of advanced computing technology being diverted to unauthorised end users or uses.

claims.claim: On November 24 Lawrence Wong said Singapore does not enforce US export controls, does not want to be a conduit, and is working with the US on an information-sharing mechanism, and that not all requested information was forthcoming.
claims.episode_span: Prime Minister Lawrence Wong said Singapore does not enforce America’s export controls but does not want to be used as a conduit
claims.source_title: S’pore working with US on chip export enforcement as Megaspeed probe continues: PM Wong
claims.supporting_quote: We do not enforce America's export controls, but we do not want Singapore to be used and abused as a conduit by companies to circumvent America's export controls

claims.claim: Anwar Ibrahim said US chip export controls will not stop Malaysia cooperating with China, that Malaysia will monitor US-tied shipments to China, and that foreign investors seeking government help to secure supply chains must pay.
claims.episode_span: US export controls aimed at restricting China’s use of advanced AI chips will not stop Malaysia from cooperating with Beijing and Chinese companies.
claims.source_title: Anwar: US chip export controls will not hinder Malaysia’s cooperation with China
claims.supporting_quote: Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said US export controls aimed at restricting China’s use of advanced artificial intelligence (AI) chips would not prevent Malaysia from cooperating with Beijing and Chinese companies.

claims.claim: Comments on the US interim final rule Addressing Remote Access to Advanced Semiconductors, effective November 19, 2026, are due January 19, 2027.
claims.episode_span: Public comments on the US Commerce Department interim final rule “Addressing Remote Access to Advanced Semiconductors,” which took effect November 19, 2026, are due January 19, 2027.
claims.source_title: TSMC China chip export controls: reported 16nm pause
claims.supporting_quote: Comments on the rule are due January 19, 2027.

claims.claim: Semiconductor Engineering reported that HLS handles control and datapath with 10 to 20 times less code than RTL, that the synthesizable C++ subset has been relatively constant for 10 to 15 years, and that a design can pass a 100 percent regression and still fail in the field.
claims.episode_span: HLS handles complex control and datapath with ten to twenty times less code than RTL.
claims.supporting_quote: HLS handles complex control logic and data path equally well, with 10 to 20 times less code than RTL, says Badru Agarwala, CEO and co-founder at Rise Design Automation.
